description:
Health MCP gives the AI assistant you choose access to your Apple Health history, with encryption and control built in.

START WITH APPLE HEALTH
Choose the data you want to share, save your private key, and launch your first sync. Follow live progress, pause and resume, and review previous runs in Sync history. After the first backfill, the app catches up on changes.

ENCRYPTED ON YOUR IPHONE
Health values are compressed and encrypted before upload. The cloud service never receives your decryption key. Export the trusted local client from the signed iPhone app to download and decrypt records on your computer.

CONNECT AN ASSISTANT YOU TRUST
The included client works with assistants that support local stdio MCP servers, including Codex CLI. It requires Node.js 22 or newer on your computer. Approve each connection with a pairing code. The client returns the health records you request to your chosen assistant, whose own privacy and retention policies apply.

CHOOSE WHAT TO SHARE
Share readable heart, sleep, movement, body measurement, workout and activity data, plus daily summaries that merge overlapping sources. Nutrition, reproductive health, symptoms, audio exposure, ECG recordings and precise workout routes are optional and off by default. Available data depends on your devices, region and Apple Health permissions.

STAY IN CONTROL
Revoke connections, remove optional data, rotate your key or delete your encrypted cache in Settings. Apple Health remains the source of truth: Health MCP never writes to it. Revocation stops future access; records an assistant already received cannot be recalled.

Background sync and push notifications depend on iOS and are best effort. The first sync works best with the app open and a good connection. V1 includes up to 2 GiB and 500,000 encrypted objects per account; contact support if you need help with these limits.

No advertising or tracking SDKs. No account password to remember. A supported local MCP assistant and private key configuration are required to use your encrypted data. Health MCP is a data connection tool and does not provide diagnosis or treatment.

Connection guide: https://healthmcp.cc/connect
Privacy: https://healthmcp.cc/privacy
Support: support@healthmcp.cc
promotionalText: Connect Apple Health to your chosen assistant. Encrypted on your iPhone, decrypted on your computer, and always under your control.
